texts.preamble: Vijendra Singh Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 24 August, 2024 Author: Pranay Verma Bench: Pranay Verma Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:24522 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma On The 24th Of August, 2024 Writ Petition No. 5007 of 2024 Vijendra Singh Rathore Versus The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others Appearance: Shri L. C. Patne, learned counsel for the petitioner. Shri Prakhar Trivedi, Panel Lawyer for the respondent/S Order
texts.facts: By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has challenged the order dated 24.05.2023 [Annexure P/2] passed by respondent No.2 whereby he has been placed under suspension on the post of Sarpanch under Section 39(1)(a) of M.P. Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993. The petitioner has also challenged the order dated 24.05.2023 [Annexure P/3] passed by respondent No.3 directing Election of Officiating Sarpanch.
texts.arguments: The petitioner has also challenged the order dated 05.12.2023 [Annexure P/6] passed by respondent No.2 whereby appeal preferred by him against the suspension order has been dismissed. 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per provisions of Section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, 1993 the Officer Bearer of Panchayat can be placed under suspension only when the charge is framed under any NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:24522 2 WP-5007-2024 criminal case mentioned under the said section. It is submitted that in the present case, case under Section 302, 307, 147, 148, 327, 294 of IPC and under Section 25 and 27 of the Arms Act has been registered against the petitioner but no charge has been framed. 3. The respondents have filed the reply to the petition but nowhere therein it has been stated as to whether any charge has been framed against the petitioner. The petitioner has made specific Vijendra Singh Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 24 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117822907/ 1 avernment in the petition that no charge has been framed in the criminal case. The respondents have only stated that the criminal case has been registered against the petitioner and upon completion of the investigation charge sheet has been filed before the Court concerned but it has not been stated whether any charge has been framed or not. 4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, it is apposite to refer relevant provision of section 39(1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, which reads as under:- "39. Suspension of office-bearer of Panchayat. - (1) The prescribed authority may suspend from office any office-bearer,- (a) against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under [Chapters V-A, VI, IX], IX-A, X, XII, Sections 302, 303, 304-B, 305, 306, 312 to 318, 366-A, 366-B, 373 to 377 of Chapter XVI, Sections 395 to 398, 408, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:24522 3 WP-5007-2024 409, 458 lo 460 of Chapter XVII and Chapter XVIII of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (XLV of 1860) or under any Law for the time being in force for the prevention of adulteration of food stuff and drugs, [suppression of immoral traffic in women and children, Protection of Civil Rights and Prevention of Corruption]; 5.
